slides.title: Welcome to Finanzor
slides.body: Your personal app to track your income, expenses, and savings month by month. Simple, visual, and designed for daily use.

slides.title: Log your transactions
slides.body: Tap the + button on Home or Transactions to add income or an expense. Category, amount, date — done in seconds.

slides.title: See where your money goes
slides.body: The Dashboard shows your income, expenses, and current balance for the month, plus a pie chart of spending by category.

slides.title: Set your budget
slides.body: Set a limit per category. The bar turns yellow at 70% and red at 90% to warn you that you're close to the limit.

slides.title: Automate recurring expenses
slides.body: Rent, gym, Netflix... Set them up once with the day of the month and they'll be created automatically every month. Pause or delete them anytime.

slides.title: Save toward your goals
slides.body: Create goals (vacation, emergency fund, a purchase) and contribute little by little. The bar shows how much is left.

slides.title: Navigate between months
slides.body: Use the header arrows to go to past or future months. Data is always sorted by the transaction's actual date.

slides.title: All set!
slides.body: Start by adding your first transaction from the + button on Home. If you ever want to see this tutorial again, it's in Settings.
